abstract.text:
We argue that BPS ansatzes, entering manifestly vacuum BPS monopole solutions to equations of
motion in the (Minkowskian) non-Abelian Higgs model play the role of some electric form-factors and
that this implies (soft) violating the CP-invariance of the mentioned model, similar to taking place
in the Euclidian Yang-Mills (YM) theory with instantons, generating the θ-term in the appropriate
effective Hamiltonian.

predecessors.cited_work: Dirac quantization / topological Dirac variables and BPS monopole literature

evidence.quote: The Dirac fundamental quantization [37] of the YMH model involving vacuum BPS monopole solutions (coming, as we have explained above, to solving the Gauss law constraint in terms of topological Dirac variables) implies some refining us said in the previous section about the CP violation in the presence of those vacuum BPS monopole solutions.

thesis.text: BPS ansatzes in the Minkowskian non-Abelian Higgs model can be interpreted as electric form-factors; their presence leads to soft CP-violation analogous to instanton θ-term effects, although Dirac quantization of the BPS-monopole vacuum is later argued to restore CP conservation.

question.text: Can BPS ansatzes f1BPS and f0BPS in the Minkowskian non-Abelian Higgs model be treated as electric form-factors, and does their presence imply CP violation analogous to instanton θ-term effects?
